pages.title: A companion for your magic
text: A **familiar** is a creature bonded to you. It follows you, waits where you tell it and never despawns, and each kind has a gift of its own ([what familiars do](familiar_gifts)).
Give it a voice at a **Resonance Totem** and it becomes part of your magic: Spirit Charms, Spiritgear, songs and rites of that voice cost less and do more while it is within **16 blocks** of you.
Magic works without a familiar. A familiar makes it stronger.

pages.title: Who can be bonded
text: - **Gentle beasts**: the Dawn Stag and Lantern Fox of forests, the Mossback of swamps, and the grazers, hoppers and moths of every March biome. Anyone can bond them.
- **Six remnants**, once their tribe calls you **Voice**: Shardback, Rift Hound, Cinder Imp, Storm Moth, Mourning Bell and Echo Weaver ([which tribe for which](familiars)).
Bosses, goblins, trolls and the March's other hostiles never answer, and the young cannot be bonded.
**Sneak and look** at a creature to see whether it can be bonded and what it needs. A Ley Lens sneak-used on it says the same.

pages.title: Bonding
text: Feed a grown one its favourite food, the way you would win over a wolf: about one try in three for gentle beasts, one in five for remnants.
Or use a **Bonding Charm** on it: three tries in five, two in five for remnants.
Make the charm early from **four String**, a **Spirit Shard** and one creature reagent. Brush a gentle beast to get its reagent. Later, two Spiritweave can stand in for the string.
The whole story, threads and breeding included: [Bonding a familiar](familiars).

pages.text: Any one of the nine creature reagents fills the middle slot.

pages.title: Keeping company
text: **One fighter** (a Shardback or Rift Hound) and **two helpers** follow at once. Sneak-use a familiar to make it wait, and again to call it back.
A waiting familiar still lends its voice whenever you come within 16 blocks, so one left sitting by your workshop helps you there.
Feed a hurt one its food. A fallen one leaves a **Spirit Remnant** that a [Healing Circle](healing_circle) calls back, voice and all.
